title: Chapter 38

native_pcm_qa.scope: Native samples before resampling; rail hits are review candidates, not proof of audible clipping
Native samples before resampling; rail hits are review candidates, not proof of audible clipping
Native samples before resampling; rail hits are review candidates, not proof of audible clipping

normalization.method: Chapter-wide gain with gentle oversampled peak limiting

limiter.scope: Peak overdrive is measured from source peak and pre-gain; it is not an exact gain-reduction statistic

master_pcm_qa.peak_scope: Decoded sample peak, not oversampled true peak
master_pcm_qa.clipping_scope: Float PCM samples at or above full scale; zero hits cannot prove that source audio was never clipped

quiet_window_measurements.scope: Non-overlapping windows within the unpadded body; these may contain pauses or quiet speech. Not noise-floor certification.

decoded_mp3_qa.peak_scope: Decoded sample peak, not oversampled true peak
decoded_mp3_qa.clipping_scope: Float PCM samples at or above full scale; zero hits cannot prove that source audio was never clipped

quiet_window_measurements.scope: Non-overlapping windows within the unpadded body; these may contain pauses or quiet speech. Not noise-floor certification.

decoded_mp3_qa.oversampled_peak_scope: 4x ffmpeg resampling peak estimate; not a standardized true-peak meter certification
decoded_mp3_qa.analysis_conversion: First audio stream decoded to mono 44.1 kHz float PCM; exported MP3 must already match this format.

scope: Technical measurements only; not listening approval, noise-floor certification, or publishing acceptance

coordinator_checks.body_pause_conservation: Only outer edges are trimmed; internal chunk samples and cadence are preserved. Gain and optional peak limiting do not change timing.
coordinator_checks.content_qa: Separate local transcription and listening review; no content approval is inferred here.
